name: Dynisma
note: Official simulator partner of Nissan Formula E Team (Season 12): it supplied the team's DMG-1 racing simulator. Companies House (company 10923412) lists Hawthorn Holdco Limited (17313112) and founder Ashley Warne as Dynisma Ltd's persons with significant control, each with more than 25% but not more than 50% of shares and voting rights. Hawthorn Holdco's own PSC entry (Companies House, company 17313112, notified July 2026) names Highvern Trustees Limited, a Jersey trustee company, as holding 75% or more of its shares and voting rights; a trust's beneficiaries are not on the public register, so Dynisma's ultimate beneficial owner is not identified. Left unrated; owner parentId is null.
